name.description: Name is the authority's URI host value.

description.description: Description documents who owns this namespace and what it is for.

Authority.description: An Authority is a registered namespace owner permitted as the host component of a reference under a Profile's scheme, for example "acme" or "contoso".

scheme.description:
Scheme is the URI scheme this profile governs, e.g. "prn". It must
match the RFC 3986 scheme grammar: a letter followed by letters,
digits, "+", "-", or ".".

uriSubset.description:
URISubset constrains which URI components an owned reference under
this scheme may use.

authorities.description:
Authorities is the registry of namespace owners permitted as the
URI host component of a reference under this scheme.

shapes.description:
Shapes are the permitted path-segment structures, tried in order;
the first shape whose segment count matches a reference's path wins.

resourceTypes.description:
ResourceTypes optionally registers known resource-type values per
authority (and, for tenant-scoped shapes, per app). A reference
whose (authority, app) pair has no registry entry here is not
restricted — the registry is opt-in and additive, not a closed list
that must be updated before a new type can be used.

version.description:
Version defines the "@version" / "@alias" suffix grammar applied to
a reference's final path segment.

Profile.description: A Profile describes an owned URI scheme as data.

authority.description:
Authority is the namespace owner this entry applies to; it must be
one of the [Profile]'s registered Authorities.

app.description:
App scopes this entry to one application's resource types under a
tenant-scoped shape. Empty applies to shapes with no app segment
(ecosystem artifacts).

types.description:
Types is the set of permitted resourceType segment values for this
(Authority, App) pair.

ResourceTypeRegistry.description: A ResourceTypeRegistry entry restricts the resourceType segment for references scoped to one authority (and, for tenant-scoped shapes, one app) to a known set of values.

role.description:
Role is the meaning of this segment: one of RoleApp, RoleOrg,
RoleResourceType, or RoleID.

rest.description:
Rest marks this as the shape's final segment, capturing one or more
remaining path segments (joined by "/") rather than exactly one.
Only RoleID segments may set Rest.

SegmentSpec.description: A SegmentSpec is one path segment of a Shape.

name.description: Name identifies the shape for diagnostics, e.g. "tenant-scoped".

segments.description:
Segments describes the path, in order, after the authority. At most
one segment may set Rest to true, and it must be the last element.

Shape.description: A Shape is one permitted path-segment structure for references under a Profile's scheme, for example a tenant-scoped shape ({app}/{org}/{resourceType}/{id}) or an ecosystem-artifact shape ({resourceType}/{id...}).

allowQuery.description:
AllowQuery permits a "?query" component on references under this
scheme.

allowUserinfo.description: AllowUserinfo permits a "user:pass@" component in the authority.

allowPort.description: AllowPort permits an explicit ":port" component in the authority.

segmentPattern.description:
SegmentPattern is a regular expression every authority and
non-version-suffixed path segment must match. Empty means no
additional charset restriction beyond valid URI syntax.

URISubset.description: URISubset constrains a scheme to a stricter subset of general URI syntax, following the SPIFFE ID specification's lead: an owned reference scheme should say plainly which components are meaningful, rather than inheriting the full generality of RFC 3986.

separator.description:
Separator is the character (or short string) that introduces the
suffix, e.g. "@". Empty means this scheme has no version suffix
grammar at all.

required.description:
Required, when true, means every reference to an invocable resource
under this scheme must carry a version or alias suffix — an
invocation layer built on this package enforces that for its
targets; this package only records the policy.

versionPattern.description:
VersionPattern is a regular expression matching an immutable
version token.

aliasPattern.description:
AliasPattern is a regular expression matching a mutable alias
token.

title: resourceref Scheme Profile
description: Data-driven definition of an owned URI scheme (resourceref/scheme.Profile). A namespace owner's own scheme instance is a document conforming to this schema, defined wherever that owner keeps its own standards.
